name: Afterlife Library: OXO
source:
After getting mortally injured in a remote tundra, you find yourself in an unfamiliar library. Its only present librarian is ready to help you out of this place, but only if you’re ready to fulfil her wish.

[From [url=https://nitunio.itch.io/afterlife-library-oxo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在偏远的苔原受致命伤后，你发现自己身处一个陌生的图书馆。它唯一在场的图书管理员随时准备帮助你离开这个地方，但前提是你准备好满足她的愿望。

[来自[url=https://nitunio.itch.io/afterlife-library-oxo]Itch.io[/url]]
